catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Organize categories, localized content, specifications, and publication status.
catalog.readOnly: Read-only access. You can inspect catalog categories but cannot change them.

editor.emptyDescription: Choose a category from the tree to inspect or edit it.
editor.sourceLanguage: Bulgarian is the source language for new drafts.

bgSlug.label: Bulgarian URL address
bgSlug.help: The address segment for the Bulgarian page. Transliterate Bulgarian words using lowercase Latin letters, numbers, and hyphens.

enSlug.label: English URL address
enSlug.help: The English address segment. Turkish and Ukrainian addresses reuse this value. Use lowercase Latin letters, numbers, and hyphens.

parent.label: Parent category
parent.help: Where this category sits in the catalog tree.

name.label: Name
name.help: Shown in the tree, as the future page heading, and by default as the search-result title. Keep it clear and natural; about 50–60 characters is useful search guidance without keyword stuffing.

introduction.label: Introduction
introduction.help: Describes the category on the page itself and is shown to visitors. The meta description is a separate, more engaging text intended for search results.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.help: A short summary of the category. It may appear in Google or Bing below the SEO title and page address. Aim for about 140–160 clear characters; search engines may show different text.
metaDescription.example: Example for a “Solar panels” category: “Explore solar panels for homes and businesses and learn how to choose a suitable model based on output, efficiency, and your project’s needs.”

productTitleGuidance.label: Product-title guidance
productTitleGuidance.help: Internal guidance for authors naming products in this category; it is not public category copy.
productTitleGuidance.example: Example: “Write the title in this order: brand and model, power, product type—for example, [Brand] [Model] 440 W monocrystalline solar panel. Do not use promotional words such as ‘best’.”

seoPreview.title: Illustrative search preview
seoPreview.note: Search engines may display different text.
seoPreview.emptyDescription: Add a clear summary to preview how this category could appear in search.

create.title: New category
create.description: Enter a working name in the current language. Nothing is saved yet; you will complete the full editor first.
create.name: Name
create.editorDescription: Complete both addresses and all language content. The category is created only after the first successful save.

move.title: Move category
move.description: Choose a new parent. The category will be appended there without renumbering siblings.

publish.title: Publish this category?
publish.description: Publication is allowed only when the category and its specifications are ready in all languages.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this category?
unpublish.description: The category will return to draft. Existing dependency rules still apply.

archive.title: Archive this category?
archive.description: The category will be retained but removed from active use. Existing dependency rules still apply.

restore.title: Restore this category?
restore.description: The category will be restored as a draft.

messages.PARENT_NOT_PUBLISHED: The parent category must be published first.
messages.MISSING_CATEGORY_TRANSLATION: Add a name and introduction in {{locale}}.
messages.SELECTION_OPTIONS_REQUIRED: Specification {{specification}} needs at least one selection option.
messages.MISSING_OPTION_TRANSLATION: Option {{option}} in {{specification}} needs a label in {{locale}}.

specifications.emptyDescription: Add a characteristic that can later be filled in for products in this category.
specifications.languageHelp: The selected language controls the names of every specification and option below. All four languages are required before saving.

preview.title: Characteristics
preview.description: This is how the section would look in a real product listing. Names and options update from your current edits.

name.label: Name
name.help: The name shown beside the value in the product characteristics.

type.label: Type
type.help: Choose whether the value is text, a number, yes/no, or one of several options.

unit.label: Unit
unit.help: Optional unit for a numeric value, for example W, kW, or kg.

specifications.optionsHelp: Add the prepared values an administrator can choose from when creating a product.

optionName.label: Option name
optionName.help: The value an administrator selects and a visitor sees in the characteristics.

specifications.confirmClearOptions: Changing type will remove all selection options. Continue?

list.title: Products
list.description: Products assigned to this category as a primary or additional category.
list.emptyDescription: Create a product here or assign an existing product to this category.

editor.newDescription: Complete the product and save it in one action. It remains a draft until publication.
editor.editDescription: Edit and save the whole product in one place.
editor.readOnly: Read-only access. You can inspect this product but cannot change it.
editor.skuPending: Generated when the product is saved
editor.unsaved: This product has unsaved changes. Continue and discard them?

preview.title: Product preview
preview.noImage: No primary image has been selected yet

sku.label: SKU
sku.help: Generated automatically and independent of category names.

primaryCategory.label: Primary category
primaryCategory.help: Defines the product specifications and title guidance.

additionalCategories.label: Additional categories
additionalCategories.help: Optional extra locations where the product should appear.

bgSlug.label: Bulgarian product address
bgSlug.help: The final segment of the Bulgarian address. The full example below includes the real domain and selected primary-category path. It can be edited until first publication.

enSlug.label: English product address
enSlug.help: The final segment of the English address. The full example below includes /en, the real category path, and the product address. It can be edited until first publication.

trSlug.label: Turkish product address
trSlug.help: Optional Turkish address. Leave it empty to use the English product address for the Turkish version.

ukSlug.label: Ukrainian product address
ukSlug.help: Optional Ukrainian address. Leave it empty to use the English product address for the Ukrainian version.

mpn.label: Model (MPN)
mpn.help: The required official model or product code assigned by the manufacturer.

salesMode.label: Sales mode
salesMode.help: Choose direct purchase or enquiry-only handling.

pricePresentation.label: Price presentation
pricePresentation.help: Choose an exact price, a starting price, or price on request.

price.label: Entered price in EUR
price.help: Enter the amount using up to two decimal places.

priceEntryBasis.label: VAT basis
priceEntryBasis.help: Choose whether the entered amount includes 20% VAT.

availability.label: Availability
availability.help: Choose availability manually; quantities are not tracked.

title.label: Product title
title.help: The public product name in this language.

shortDescription.label: Short description
shortDescription.help: A concise summary for product listings.

fullDescription.label: Full description
fullDescription.help: The complete product description in this language.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.help: May appear below the title and address in search results.

mediaReference.label: Media reference
mediaReference.help: Use an existing site path or HTTPS URL.

altText.label: Alternative text
altText.help: Describe this image in the selected language.

customUnit.label: Unit
customUnit.help: Optional unit, such as W or kg.

customOption.label: Option
customOption.help: The option name in the selected language.
